record.question: The Schedule Y drugs are:
options: Drugs that are in used in pre-clinical studies
Drugs that are used for only rare diseases
Drugs that are currently used in clinical trials
Drugs that have high abuse liability
record.explanation: Official final key: C — Drugs that are currently used in clinical trials. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 9, printed Q64. The key reflects the older Schedule Y clinical-trial framework. This is historical terminology rather than a complete account of current drug/clinical-trial rules.
